label: Requirements Definition
description: Convert goals into requirements, acceptance criteria, and constraints.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to define requirements or scope.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for a final implementation patch.

label: Roadmap Planning
description: Build phased plans, milestones, dependencies, and rollout sequencing.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a roadmap or phased implementation plan.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for a code review finding list.

label: Release Roadmap
description: Plan phased release work, readiness gates, changelog, docs, packaging, and rollout steps.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for release planning, alpha/beta sequencing, or launch readiness.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to publish immediately without planning.

label: Task Decomposition
description: Break a goal into tasks, phases, or executable work items.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to split work into steps or tickets.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for source citation research.

label: Milestone Planning
description: Define milestones, gates, sequencing, and completion criteria.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for milestones or phased delivery.

label: Sprint Planning
description: Plan sprint scope, backlog slices, and delivery sequencing.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for sprint or iteration planning.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for long-term strategy only.

label: Acceptance Criteria
description: Write acceptance criteria and verifiable completion checks.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what must be true for work to be done.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for code review only.

label: Rollout Planning
description: Plan rollout stages, risks, communications, and rollback points.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to roll something out.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for a single announcement.

label: Dependency Mapping
description: Map prerequisites, blockers, owners, and sequencing dependencies.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what depends on what.

label: Resource Planning
description: Estimate effort, staffing, ownership, and resource needs.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what resources are needed.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for exact budget accounting.
